**Pantone “Sky Blue” – commonly used reference**

| Pantone Code | Description / Notes |
|--------------|---------------------|
| **Pantone 15‑3919** | Often listed simply as *“Sky Blue.”* It’s a bright, mid‑tone blue that matches the classic image of a clear daytime sky. |
| **Pantone 14‑4210** | Labeled *“Light Blue,”* this hue sits slightly lighter than #15‑3919 and is sometimes chosen when designers prefer a softer sky tone. |

> **Why two codes?**  
> Pantone doesn’t publish a single “official” code called *Sky Blue.* Designers usually pick either #15‑3919 (the brighter version) or #14‑4210 (a gentler light blue) depending on how vivid they want the finish to appear. Both fall within the same general family of pale blues often associated with daylight skies.
